sentences.en: Speaking of book club drama, can I please share the letter I told you not to read now?
sentences.zh: 说到读书会的狗血剧情，我现在可以分享那封我让你别读的信了吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: This letter is from Daphne B.
sentences.zh: 这封信来自蒙大拿州的达芙妮·B。

sentences.en: in Montana.
sentences.zh: 来自蒙大拿州。

sentences.en: Daphne wrote in and said,
sentences.zh: 达芙妮写信来说，

sentences.en: I am part of a book club that has a main group of girls and then some other ladies.
sentences.zh: 我参加了一个读书俱乐部，里面有一个核心成员小组，还有一些其他女士。

sentences.en: It's usually like 15-ish girls, and every month, 10 to 12 show up, and it's a super great time and a fun way to get some girl time.
sentences.zh: 通常有15个左右的女孩，每个月会有10到12个人参加，大家玩得很开心，也是一种享受闺蜜时光的有趣方式。

sentences.en: Well, one of the main girls texted our big chat that she wasn't going to be part of the book club anymore, which shocked me.
sentences.zh: 结果，其中一个核心成员在我们的群聊里发消息说她不再参加读书俱乐部了，这让我很震惊。

sentences.en: Shocked in all caps.
sentences.zh: 是大写加粗的震惊。

sentences.en: So I knew something was wrong.
sentences.zh: 所以我知道出事了。

sentences.en: At the next book club, I got the tea.
sentences.zh: 在下一次读书会时，我打听到了内幕。

sentences.en: Apparently, the girl that left the club, let's call her Lucy.
sentences.zh: 显然，那个退出俱乐部的女孩，我们叫她露西吧。

sentences.en: You know we love it.
sentences.zh: 你知道我们最爱这个了。

sentences.en: We love this.
sentences.zh: 我们太爱这个了。

sentences.en: When we have to have a code name.
sentences.zh: 当我们不得不使用代号的时候。

sentences.en: Please give us all the code names.
sentences.zh: 请务必给我们所有的代号。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So apparently the girl that left the club, let's call her Lucy,
sentences.zh: 所以显然那个退出俱乐部的女孩，我们叫她露西，

sentences.en: was because all the other main group of friends had confronted her as an entire group because Lucy and her husband and another girl from the book club
sentences.zh: 是因为其他核心朋友圈的人集体质问了她，因为露西和她丈夫，还有读书俱乐部里的另一个女孩，

sentences.en: that is also not a part of the main friend group.
sentences.zh: 那个女孩也不属于核心朋友圈。

sentences.en: Let's call her Hannah.
sentences.zh: 我们叫她汉娜吧。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: They all got it on.
sentences.zh: 他们全都搞在了一起。

sentences.en: Wait.
sentences.zh: 等等。

sentences.en: Hannah, Lucy, and Lucy's husband had a threesome.
sentences.zh: 汉娜、露西和露西的丈夫玩了三人行。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But Hannah and Lucy are in the book club together.
sentences.zh: 但汉娜和露西都在同一个读书俱乐部里。

sentences.en: They were.
sentences.zh: 她们曾经是。

sentences.en: She goes on to say, Hannah had already left the group.
sentences.zh: 她接着说，汉娜已经退出了小组。

sentences.en: And then in parentheses, she said she only ever came to a few book clubs.
sentences.zh: 然后在括号里，她说汉娜只来过几次读书会。

sentences.en: But Lucy was confronted about her husband being the worst and how she should leave him.
sentences.zh: 但露西被质问了，因为她丈夫是个渣男，大家劝她离开他。

sentences.en: The whole group confronted her.
sentences.zh: 整个小组都去质问她了。

sentences.en: Well, mind you, this made me laugh.
sentences.zh: 嗯，提醒一下，这让我笑了。

sentences.en: Mind you, this book club is filled with a bunch of what I thought to be vanilla married ladies.
sentences.zh: 提醒一下，这个读书俱乐部里满是我以为的那种平淡无奇的已婚女士。

sentences.en: And a lot have young kids.
sentences.zh: 而且很多人都有年幼的孩子。

sentences.en: Well, Lucy chose to stand by her man and now isn't talking to anyone in the group and told them all off.
sentences.zh: 好吧，露西选择支持她的丈夫，现在不和小组里的任何人说话，还把她们都骂了一顿。

sentences.en: Daphne wraps it up by saying,
sentences.zh: 达芙妮在结尾说，

sentences.en: I am a mom of a little one and this book club has been a fun way for me to get out of the house
sentences.zh: 我是一个小宝宝的妈妈，这个读书俱乐部一直是我走出家门的一种有趣方式，

sentences.en: and have some adult time one evening a month.
sentences.zh: 每个月能有一个晚上享受成年人的时光。

sentences.en: And I love the good fantasy books.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢那些精彩的奇幻小说。

sentences.en: Side note, Angela would love our books.
sentences.zh: 顺便提一下，安吉拉一定会喜欢我们的书。

sentences.en: But this whole situation is awkward now.
sentences.zh: 但现在整个局面变得很尴尬。

sentences.en: And I'm so happy I wasn't involved and was completely clueless about the whole situation.
sentences.zh: 我很庆幸自己没有卷入其中，对整件事完全一无所知。

sentences.en: So what do you think, office ladies?
sentences.zh: 那么你们怎么看，办公室女士们？

sentences.en: Should I stick out the awkwardness now that I know or should I leave?
sentences.zh: 既然我已经知道了，我是该忍受这种尴尬继续待下去，还是应该离开？

sentences.en: And that's the tea.
sentences.zh: 这就是全部内幕了。

sentences.en: Well.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: I mean, Lucy has told this whole group to F off.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，露西已经让整个小组滚蛋了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Hannah's not coming anymore.
sentences.zh: 汉娜也不会再来了。

sentences.en: I mean, listen, the two problems in this story are not at the book club anymore.
sentences.zh: 我是说，听着，这个故事里的两个问题已经不在读书俱乐部里了。

sentences.en: That is true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: That is true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: I guess you just have to wonder, though.
sentences.zh: 不过我想你还是会忍不住好奇。

sentences.en: When are they going to turn on someone else?
sentences.zh: 她们什么时候会把矛头转向别人呢？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Are they going to meddle in someone else's marriage and personal lives?
sentences.zh: 她们会去干涉别人的婚姻和私生活吗？

sentences.en: Have a group meeting to tell you your husband's the worst?
sentences.zh: 还要开个小组会议告诉你，你丈夫是世界上最糟糕的人？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Well, I mean, there's two ladies who didn't think he was the worSt.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我是说，还有两位女士不觉得他是最糟糕的。

sentences.en: Apparently.
sentences.zh: 显然是这样。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But also, like, do book clubs always get that personal?
sentences.zh: 但话说回来，读书俱乐部总是这么私人化吗？

sentences.en: Lady, I know we're getting ready to wrap it up, but I actually have one more letter.
sentences.zh: 女士，我知道我们准备要结束了，但我其实还有一封信。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Funny you should ask if they get personal.
sentences.zh: 你问得真巧，问她们是不是总是这么私人化。

sentences.en: This letter made me chuckle, and it made me think of Phyllis.
sentences.zh: 这封信让我忍俊不禁，也让我想起了菲利斯。

sentences.en: Our Phyllis?
sentences.zh: 我们的菲利斯？

sentences.en: Our Phyllis Lapp in Vance.
sentences.zh: 万斯的菲利斯·拉普。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: It's from Natalie P in Nashville, Tennessee, who said,
sentences.zh: 这是来自田纳西州纳什维尔的娜塔莉·P写的，她说：

sentences.en: Years ago, our book club read Fifty Shades of Grey.
sentences.zh: 几年前，我们的读书俱乐部读了《五十度灰》。

sentences.en: Oh.
sentences.zh: 哦。

sentences.en: I remember my friend recommending it, and everyone in the room looked uneasy.
sentences.zh: 我记得我朋友推荐它的时候，房间里的每个人看起来都很不安。

sentences.en: I had not heard of it, so I spoke up and naively and energetically said,
sentences.zh: 我当时没听说过这本书，所以我天真又充满活力地开口说：

sentences.en: Yeah, let's do it.
sentences.zh: 好啊，我们就读这本吧。

sentences.en: It's your choice.
sentences.zh: 这是你的选择。

sentences.en: Natalie said,
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉说：

sentences.en: I bought the book, luckily on my iPad, because I brought it to school to read during lunch.
sentences.zh: 我买了这本书，幸好是在iPad上买的，因为我把它带到学校午休时看。

sentences.en: I'm a high school teacher.
sentences.zh: 我是一名高中老师。

sentences.en: Now I know why you said it makes you think of Phyllis Vance.
sentences.zh: 现在我知道你为什么说这让你想起万斯的菲利斯了。

sentences.en: And Natalie said, a few chapters in, I was horrified of what I was reading in broad daylight.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莉接着说，读了几章之后，我被自己在光天化日之下读的内容吓坏了。

sentences.en: So Natalie said, anyway, in a group of about—this is the part that cracked me up—in a group of about 12 ladies, eight of us got pregnant.
sentences.zh: 所以娜塔莉说，总之，在一个大约——这部分让我笑喷了——在一个大约12人的女士小组里，我们有8个人怀孕了。

sentences.en: The book club fell apart, and my husband likes to call the kids the gravies.
sentences.zh: 读书俱乐部解散了，我丈夫喜欢把这些孩子称为“意外之喜”。

sentences.en: That is fantastic.
sentences.zh: 这太棒了。

sentences.en: Oh, my goodness.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Well, everyone, that was our Finer Things Club.
sentences.zh: 好了，各位，以上就是我们的“精致事物俱乐部”。

sentences.en: We had so much fun prepping this episode, doing this episode, hearing from you about your snooty clubs.
sentences.zh: 我们准备这期节目、录制这期节目，以及听你们分享那些势利俱乐部的事情，真的非常开心。

sentences.en: It was just a delight, start to finish.
sentences.zh: 从头到尾都让人愉悦。

sentences.en: This whole work week was so fun.
sentences.zh: 整个工作周都太有趣了。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: Culminating in our tea party with Sam and Cassie.
sentences.zh: 最后还有我们和萨姆、卡西的茶话会。

sentences.en: And lady, you know, when we originally broke down Branch Wars, we said we were going to start our own Finer Things Club.
sentences.zh: 女士，你知道，当我们最初拆解《分部战争》那集时，我们说过要成立自己的“精致事物俱乐部”。

sentences.en: We were going to read all the books that they read.
sentences.zh: 我们要读她们读过的所有书。

sentences.en: I remember.
sentences.zh: 我记得。

sentences.en: We never did it, but honestly, I think it's because I don't have a huge interest in the books that they read.
sentences.zh: 我们从来没做过，但老实说，我觉得是因为我对她们读的那些书没什么太大的兴趣。

sentences.en: But I would do a Finer Things Club with you.
sentences.zh: 但我愿意和你一起办个“精致事物俱乐部”。

sentences.en: Do you remember talking about this?
sentences.zh: 你还记得我们谈过这个吗？

sentences.en: I do.
sentences.zh: 我记得。

sentences.en: I do.
sentences.zh: 我记得。

sentences.en: And you actually said we could call it Finer's Things Club because—
sentences.zh: 而且你真的说我们可以把它叫作“更精致事物俱乐部”，因为——

sentences.en: Oh, yes.
sentences.zh: 噢，是的。

sentences.en: Because I can never say it correctly.
sentences.zh: 因为我总是说不对这个名字。

sentences.en: And I want you to know the mental focus I have had to have every time we have said it in this episode.
sentences.zh: 而且我想让你知道，这集里每次提到这个名字时，我得有多么专注。

sentences.en: You did great.
sentences.zh: 你做得很好。

sentences.en: Well, I stumbled once or twice, but I really had to say Finer Things Club.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我磕巴了一两次，但我真的得说出“更精致事物俱乐部”这个名字。

sentences.en: I had to think about it.
sentences.zh: 我得好好琢磨一下。

sentences.en: And, you know, last time we shared that there was a blooper of me doing this, but we didn't play it.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，上次我们提到我有个说错名字的NG片段，但我们没放出来。

sentences.en: And a lot of people were like, you should play the blooper.
sentences.zh: 很多人都说，你们应该放那个NG片段。

sentences.en: Do you have it?
sentences.zh: 你有吗？

sentences.en: I have it.
sentences.zh: 我有。

sentences.en: Oh, you have to play.
sentences.zh: 噢，你一定要放出来。

sentences.en: I want to hear it.
sentences.zh: 我想听听。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.zh: 说“更精致事物俱乐部”没问题，但“更精致的……”

sentences.zh: “更精致的……”

sentences.zh: “更精致的……”

sentences.zh: 好吧，女士，我愿意和你一起创办“更精致事物俱乐部”。

sentences.en: It's hard for me to say Finer's Things.
sentences.zh: 对我来说说出“更精致事物”真的很难。

sentences.en: Finer's Things Club.
sentences.zh: “更精致事物俱乐部”。

sentences.en: But I'll start that club with you.
sentences.zh: 但我愿意和你一起创办那个俱乐部。

sentences.en: But I just—I don't know.
sentences.zh: 但我只是——我不知道。

sentences.en: What if our Finer's Things Club is just going around and having tea at different places and going to art museums?
sentences.zh: 如果我们的“更精致事物俱乐部”只是到处喝喝下午茶、逛逛艺术博物馆呢？

sentences.en: That is absolutely fine with me.
sentences.zh: 我完全没意见。

sentences.en: You don't even have to read any books if you don't want to.
sentences.zh: 如果你不想的话，甚至连书都不用读。

sentences.en: Well, if history has taught us anything today, it's that you start a book club with people and it falls apart.
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果说今天历史教会了我们什么，那就是你和别人办读书俱乐部，最后总是会散伙。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And they feel like relationships implode.
sentences.zh: 而且感觉人际关系都会崩塌。

sentences.en: It's true.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: So we can't start one.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不能办那个。

sentences.en: We also remember we're going to start an office ladies movie club that we never did as well.
sentences.zh: 我们也记得我们还打算办一个“办公室女士电影俱乐部”，结果也没办成。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Well, I like this idea of tea and art, museums, and movies.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我喜欢喝茶、看艺术、逛博物馆和看电影这个主意。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.zh: “更精致事物俱乐部”。

sentences.zh: 我们就把那些关于书的闹剧拒之门外吧。

sentences.zh: 在结束之前，我还有最后一件事想分享。

sentences.zh: 我觉得这可能是结束本集的一种有趣方式，毕竟我们是从安迪开始聊起的。
